description: Gets you an alert by webhook when a new article matches your search, tickers or SQL filter, with how it treats each ticker it mentions. Webhooks need a paid plan (Free has no webhook slots). Takes Query news's filters (search, ticker, universe, min_relevance, q); one of search/ticker/universe/q is required, since the whole market is about 6,000 articles a weekday. Fires as new matching articles land; each article fires once. Each delivery is `event: "news.fired"` with `articles`, each the Query news row (or `select`) plus `mentions`.

channel.description: Delivery channel: `webhook` (POST to `target_url`), `discord` (an embed at `discord_url`), `in_app` (the dashboard only) or `mobile_push` (to `device_id`). Inferred when omitted: `discord` if `discord_url` is set, else `mobile_push` if `device_id` is set, else `webhook` if `target_url` is set, else `in_app`. See Delivery channels.

device_id.description: Only with `channel=mobile_push`. Device to notify, from `POST /v2/devices/register`. An unknown id is a 400 `device_not_found`.

discord_url.description: Only with `channel=discord`. Discord incoming-webhook URL (`https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…`). Stored as a posting credential: the create response echoes it back under `channel_config`, but every later read (list, get, deliveries) strips it and sets `channel_config_present: true` instead.

min_relevance.description: Only with `ticker` or `universe`. Only articles about one of the tickers (its `relevance` at least this value, 0 to 1).

name.description: Display name, up to 80 characters. Defaults to `news: <scope> · <search or q>`.

q.description: The filter, as on Query news: article fields and the per-mention fields `ticker`, `relevance`, `sentiment_score` and `sentiment`. An article fires once when any of its mentions matches.

search.description: Full-text search over `title` + `summary`, as on Query news.

select.description: The article fields each delivered article carries, besides `id` and `mentions` (always sent). Names only. Omitted: the Query news default row.

target_url.description: Only with `channel=webhook`. HTTPS URL each delivery is POSTed to.

ticker.description: One ticker or a comma list (up to 50): articles that mention any of them. Not combinable with `universe`.

universe.description: Scope to a built-in universe (`top_10`, `top_100`) or one of your own, by id. An unknown one is a 400 `universe_not_found` naming it. Articles that mention any member fire.

name: tickerbot_subscribe_news
